name: JARVIS 2D / Matbench jdft2d

dft_exfoliation_energy.instruction: Predict the DFT-calculated exfoliation energy per atom for this periodic two-dimensional crystal structure.
dft_exfoliation_energy.field_description: lattice_vectors_angstrom: Three lattice vectors as a 3x3 row matrix in angstrom.; sites: Ordered atomic sites with element symbols and fractional coordinates relative to the lattice. Coordinates outside [0,1) are valid periodic representations.; periodic: Periodic boundary conditions along all three lattice directions; the slab cell includes vacuum.

field_descriptions.lattice_vectors_angstrom: Three lattice vectors as a 3x3 row matrix in angstrom.
field_descriptions.sites: Ordered atomic sites with element symbols and fractional coordinates relative to the lattice. Coordinates outside [0,1) are valid periodic representations.
field_descriptions.periodic: Periodic boundary conditions along all three lattice directions; the slab cell includes vacuum.

split_policy: Unassigned. Use reduced-composition groups for family holdout. These are not official Matbench fivefold assignments and no official benchmark result is claimed.
missing_policy: No labels are imputed. Only complete supported structures and finite observed source labels are emitted.
precision_policy: Candidate keeps parsed source numbers. Release formatter caps all numeric values at 12 significant digits.

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.evidence: Original Figshare article 6815705 version 1 API license field.

quality_findings: All 636 labels, lattice matrices, species and fractional coordinates match the original licensed Figshare snapshot row by row.
Only lattice, full-occupancy species, fractional coordinates and periodic boundary flags are input; DFT energies used to generate the target are excluded.
Coordinates outside the unit interval are valid periodic representations and are retained; no artificial clipping/wrapping is applied.
Composition groups conservatively prevent polymorph/alternative-cell separation; structure equivalence is not separately claimed.
Labels are calculated DFT values and inputs are relaxed source geometries; this is not an experimental or raw pre-DFT-geometry benchmark.
source_citation: Choudhary K et al. (2017), https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-017-05402-0. JARVIS 2D snapshot jdft_2d-7-7-2018.json v1, https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.6815705.v1. Matbench structure/exfoliation_en packaging by the Matbench/matminer authors.
grouping_rule: Reduced exact elemental composition, computed from full-occupancy sites. Equivalent crystals with alternative cells/site orders share composition group; this intentionally also groups distinct polymorphs.
source_version: JARVIS 2D 2018-07-07 v1 / Matbench cached gzip SHA256
deduplication_rule: Same task, normalized input, normalized label AND official split; preserve all source_refs. Across-split copies retained and flagged, same-input dependencies unioned. Different labels retained.
sample_id_rule: sha256([task_id,input_hash,label,split]) first 24 hex; official split included to preserve split occurrences.
